title: Is Qaid e Sitam Me
body:
Baba mere baba
Baba mere baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bazar ja rhi hun be maqna be chadar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ruksar khu'n mein tar hai lagte hai tamache
Qaid e sitam se mujhko koi to bacha le
Qaidi bana ke mujhko hanste hai sitamgar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sukhi hui zuba'n par aur sukhe dahen par
Khao rahem sitamgar Asghar ki bahen par
Kehti thi binte Sarwar aada se ye rokar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aghyar ka hai majma hai sar kaise uthaun
Chadar nhi hai kaise chehre ko chupau'n
Roti hun jb tamache bas lagte hai rukhpar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Karke aseer humko dar dar na phirao
Pani dikha dikha ke ab yu'n ma bahao
Tashna dahen hun pani kb hoga mayassar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Is kamsani mein itni eeza hai uthayi
Durro'n ke zakhm mere dete hai gawahi
Zinda'n ki zindagi se marjana hai behtar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye yateem hun main din kaisa hai aaya
Deta nhi hai koi ab mujhko dilasa
Zinda'n ka hai andhera aur khaq ka bistar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimre layeen ki yunhi gar jor o jafa ho
Ye iltija hai rab se bas sabr ata ho
Hoga sukoo'n mayassar ab qaid se chutkar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehsus kar rhi hun mariza ki tarah main
Lagne lagi hun haye zayifa ki tarah main
Le jaao mujhko baba zalim se bacha kar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
Azhar tadap rhi thi zinda'n me Sakina
Ammar bas ye roke kehti thi hazina
Sone na de rhe hai be rehm sitamgar
Baba mere baba
Is qaid e sitam mein mar jaye na dukhtar
author: Azhar Gopalpuri
